source: HDB site plan for the project, on the HDB Flat Portal
stack_note: Stack numbers are the last digits of the unit number (e.g. #12-157 is stack 157 on the 12th storey), read from HDB's site plan. Facing notes are my reading of the plan [Estimate].

blocks.notes: 209 and 211 are rental flats up to the 12th storey and 2-room Flexi (Type 2) on the 13th to 15th. 207, 209 and 211 face north-east over Tengah Garden Avenue.
239 and 241 are rental flats up to the 5th storey and 2-room Flexi (Type 2) from the 6th. 217 and 219 face south-west towards the car park and the PIE beyond the waterbody reserve.
251 and 253 are rental flats up to the 12th storey and 2-room Flexi (Type 2) on the 13th to 15th. 247 to 253 face north-east over Tengah Garden Avenue.
Four of the red stacks are rental flats up to the 11th storey, with 2-room Flexi (Type 2) on the 12th to 15th. 259 to 263 and 287 to 289 face north-west over Plantation Walk.
313 and 315 are rental flats up to the 6th storey and 2-room Flexi (Type 2) from the 7th. 303 and 305 face the car park and the waterbody reserve and PIE to the south-west.

notes: All blocks are 15 storeys, so the floor premium is small. Facing (park, school or PIE) matters more here.
